recognize_zh: 淋巴結大部分被小淋巴球（CLL）取代，其中另有成片的大型細胞（核仁明顯、細胞質豐富），並沿周邊竇浸潤；大細胞CD20陰性、EMA與MUM-1陽性、EBER與HHV8核染色陽性，指向結外型原發性積液淋巴瘤作為Richter轉化。
features: Lymph node with a background of small mature lymphocytes and discrete nodules of large cells (A)
Large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli, sharply demarcated from small CLL cells (B)
Large neoplastic cells distending subcapsular/peripheral sinuses (C)
Immunostains: small cells CD5+ (D) and CD20+ with CD20-negative large-cell nodules (E); large cells EMA+ (F), MUM-1+ (G)
Large cells EBER-positive by in situ hybridization (H) with stippled nuclear HHV8/LANA positivity (I)
describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows effacement by a small lymphocytic infiltrate consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia, within which are solid nodules of large cells and focal sinusoidal involvement. The large cells have abundant cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli. Immunohistochemistry shows the small cells to be CD5 and CD20 positive, whereas the large cells are CD20 negative and express EMA and MUM-1, with EBER positivity by in situ hybridization and stippled nuclear HHV8 (LANA) staining. Findings are consistent with extracavitary (solid) primary effusion lymphoma arising in the setting of chronic lymphocytic leukemia, representing an unusual Richter-type transformation.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (classic Richter transformation)
ddx.vs: Richter DLBCL retains CD20/PAX5 expression and is HHV8 negative, whereas PEL cells lack B-cell antigens and are LANA positive.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shares the CD20-negative, MUM-1/EMA-positive, EBV-positive profile but is HHV8 negative; LANA staining is the discriminator.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and are scattered in an inflammatory background rather than forming HHV8-positive sheets.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with T-cell or null phenotype, strong uniform CD30 and no HHV8 or immunoglobulin light-chain expression.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD5, CD20, EMA, MUM-1, HHV8; ISH: EBER
